newsitem.title: GERMANY: German 1997 food oilseeds area put at 741,000 ha.
newsitem.headline: German 1997 food oilseeds area put at 741,000 ha.

text.p: German oilseeds plantings for harvest in 1997 are pegged at 741,000 hectares, 95,459 ha short of the maximum allowed under the Blair House accord, a private farmers survey said.
The survey by the Union for the Promotion of Oil and Protein Crops covered winter and spring plantings of rapeseed and sunseed, excluding crops planted for industrial use.
Winter rapeseed plantings were put at 681,000 ha, up 2.6 percent from 1995/96, the survey said.
Intended spring rapeseed plantings were put at 28,000 ha after 68,600 in 1996.
Sunseed plantings were estimated at 32,000 ha against 36,300 previously.
The Bonn farm ministry plans to issue official plantings data in the week starting February 24.
The ministry put the 1996 harvest of oilseeds for food use at 651,000 ha and the area for industrial use at 247,000.
